tvShow.name: Draw This, Then Die!
tvShow.overview: First-year high school student Ai Yasumi lives on the island of Izu Oshima and loves reading manga. But after a certain turning point, she sets her sights on creating stories of her own! As she dives into the world of manga-making, Ai faces challenges, growth, and the excitement of chasing her creative dreams. Where will her creative journey take her?

episodes.name: Magic House ~ What Would a Manga Protagonist Do Here?
episodes.overview: Ai Yasumi’s love for manga inspires her to start creating stories of her own.

episodes.name: You Are Brilliant ~ Drawing Manga Is Hard
episodes.overview: Ai draws manga for the first time in order to convince Teshima-sensei to become the manga club's advisor.

episodes.name: Kokoro's Heart ~ Draw This, Then Die!!!!
episodes.overview: While on the search for a third manga club member, Ai comes across Kokoro, an introvert with a talent for art.

episodes.name: Utopia ~ Making Manga's Better With Others
episodes.overview: Ai and Kokoro begin a long process of trial and error as they try and create their first manga as a club.

episodes.name: Let's All Go Together! ~ Put Your Feelings Into Manga
episodes.overview: The Manga Research Club decides to release a manga at Comitia, but first they must get through final exams.

episodes.name: Comitia ~ Let's Make Manga That's Even More Interesting!
episodes.overview: Comitia is finally here, and the members of the Manga Research Club learn how hard it is to sell doujinshi.

episodes.name: The Lost World ~ Draw With the Intent to Kill
episodes.overview: On the ferry back from Tokyo, Rei remembers her time as a manga artist assistant while pursuing serialization.

episodes.name: Touch ~ 100 Things I Want to Draw for Manga!!!
episodes.overview: The Manga Research Club explores the island of Oshima in hopes of finding inspiration for Ai's next manga.

episodes.name: Surfing the Cyber Seas ~ Draw for Yourself, Not for Others!
episodes.overview: Ai and the others decide to create a social media account to promote their manga before the next Comitia.
